content: Image update automation: two patterns — CI writes the new tag back to the GitOps repo (explicit, simple), or ArgoCD Image Updater watches GHCR and commits/PRs tag bumps. Renovate is broader (Helm charts, npm, terraform) and recommended as the first dependency-automation tool. Image Updater does not handle Helm values files well. For a solo pipeline, CI-writes-tag or Image Updater both work; Renovate valuable for keeping platform charts fresh.
